description: This file extends and customizes stock move and stock picking models in Odoo, adding links to purchase orders and related invoice handling methods.

classes.name: stock_move
classes.description: Extension of stock.move to include purchase_line_id link.

classes.name: stock_picking
classes.description: Extension of stock.picking to include purchase_id link and invoice-related methods.

methods.name: get_currency_id
methods.description: Returns the currency ID associated with the purchase order if available.

methods.name: _get_comment_invoice
methods.description: Generates invoice comment including purchase order notes.

methods.name: _get_price_unit_invoice
methods.description: Retrieves unit price from purchase line if available.

methods.name: _get_discount_invoice
methods.description: Returns zero discount if purchase line exists.

methods.name: _get_taxes_invoice
methods.description: Returns taxes associated with the purchase line.

methods.name: _get_account_analytic_invoice
methods.description: Returns analytic account ID from purchase line.

methods.name: _invoice_line_hook
methods.description: Hook for additional invoice line processing.

methods.name: _invoice_hook
methods.description: Associates invoice ID with purchase order on invoice creation.
